name: Guqile FS06 Dual-Fan Phone Cooler
description:
Cooling Technology: Utilizes dual semiconductor chips and a dual-fan system for rapid heat dissipation. 
Features: Includes RGB backlighting, a live digital temperature display, and low-noise operation (under 25dB). 
Compatibility: Features a clamp mechanism compatible with most iPhone and Android devices ranging from 6-8cm in width
